Heard Mr. S. Rahman, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. B. Sarma, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam for the State.

2. The petitioner, namely, Md. Nur Mahammad @ Nur Mahammad Ali, son of Suruj Miyan, resident of Village- Karayani Siparia Chapari, Police Station-Sootea, District-Biswanath, has filed this application under Section 483 BNSS seeking bail in Special (POCSO) Case No.30/2019 arising out of Sootea Police Station Case No.94/2019, registered under Sections 376 IPC read with Section 4 of the POCSO Act, wherein he was arrested on 28.10.2024, and in custody since then, presently pending in the Court of learned Special Judge (POCSO), Biswanath, Biswanath Chariali.

entities.text: Md. Nur Mahammad @ Nur Mahammad Ali
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text: 3. On instruction of the petitioner, Mr. S. Rahman, learned counsel prays for withdrawal of this bail application, to which, Mr. B. Sarma, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam, has no objection.
5. Accordingly, this bail application stands dismissed, on withdrawal.
